company.name: K-Scale Labs
company.shortDescription: K-Scale Labs is a robotic engineering company specializing in creating open-source humanoid robots.
company.description: K-Scale Labs develops embodied AI systems aimed at enhancing robot interaction with the environment. Its main product, K-Bot, is a humanoid robot platform designed for flexibility, capable of running various AI models and preloaded with K-Scale OS, an operating system that integrates multimodal AI for vision, language, and action. K-Scale OS is built using Rust to provide reliability and performance tailored for robotics workflows. K-Bot supports customization and repairability, allowing developers to adapt the platform to their needs. The company also offers open-source tools to help developers train, deploy, monitor, and debug humanoid robot applications. Additionally, it provides a cash-back program to encourage data sharing and reduce development costs.
